游戏工作室并购后超六成出现不同程度发展问题
389家游戏工作室并购调查：34%关停，腾讯收购后50%表现不佳，网易为33%
过去十多年，游戏行业经历了数轮大规模并购。对于大型游戏公司而言，收购一家成熟工作室，意味着可以快速获得开发团队、成熟IP、技术积累以及进入新市场的机会。相比从零开始建立研发团队，直接收购似乎是一条更高效的扩张路径。
近日，游戏行业研究项目Game Studio Unlocked发布了一份关于游戏工作室并购后命运的调查报告。报告对2000年以来大型及中型游戏公司收购的389家PC、主机游戏工作室进行了调查，试图回答一个问题：当一家工作室成为大型游戏集团的一部分，它最终会变得更强大，还是逐渐失去原有的创造力？
研究结果并不乐观。在359家游戏开发工作室中，122家最终关停，占比34%；另有96家被归类为表现下降。也就是说， 60.7%的被收购工作室在作品表现或组织存续方面出现了不同程度的问题。
而在这份名单中，既有EA、微软、索尼等传统游戏巨头，也有腾讯、网易等近年来积极拓展海外研发版图的中国厂商。

sources.evidenceText:
XBOX’s 25th anniversary has arrived in Candy Crush Saga. Out now, the Game On! Season brings together Halo, Fallout, Sea of Thieves, Forza, DOOM,
Candy Crush Saga Gives Halo, Fallout, Forza and More a Sweet Makeover for XBOX’s 25th
XBOX’s 25th anniversary has arrived in Candy Crush Saga . Out now, the Game On! Season brings together Halo, Fallout, Sea of Thieves, Forza, DOOM, Banjo-Kazooie, Crash Bandicoot and Spyro for four weeks of collectible pins and some very familiar music with a distinctly Candy Crush sound.
For anyone who’s spent years with these games, there’s plenty to recognize. But putting them in the Candy Kingdom meant working out which details to keep, which to play with.
At the center of the season is an XBOX 25 pin collection. Players earn pins as they progress through Candy Crush Saga levels, collecting characters and moments from across all eight franchises. Look out for Master Chief’s helmet, DOOM’s Cacodemon and Crash Bandicoot’s Dr. Neo Cortex, alongside Candy Crush characters getting into costume.
The teams behind those worlds worked with King on the designs. For Halo, that meant finding room for both the franchise’s most recognizable armor and the personalities of the characters wearing it.
“Halo’s music is such an iconic part of the franchise, and seeing it ‘candified’ into something playful and unexpected, while still being unmistakably Halo, was a lot of fun,” Corrine Robinson, Sr. Halo Franchise Manager, explains. “We took the same approach with the pins: start with the Candy Crush characters and bring in some of the most recognizable elements of Halo. Tiffi in pink Mjolnir armor, topped off with her signature bow, was a perfect Spartan mash-up, while Dachs in Grunt armor quickly became my personal favorite. The Candy Crush team was a fantastic creative partner, and we enjoyed bringing our two very different worlds together in a way that feels authentic to both franchises and, most importantly, fun for the fans.”
Fallout takes the costume changes in another direction. Vault Boy makes an appearance, Dachs borrows Dogmeat’s armor, and Bubblegum Troll gets a Vault Suit. As Daniel Lee, Associate Art Director at Bethesda Game Studios, points out, the Wasteland already knows a thing or two about candy:
“Sugar Bombs, Fancy Lad Snack Cakes, Radioactive Gumdrops, the Wasteland is certainly no stranger to sweet treats. Working with King to bring together two vastly different worlds together has been a real pleasure.

sources.label: PlayStation Blog
sources.evidenceText:
Starry Studio dev on weaponizing emotion and melody.
Once Human: Season 5 gameplay showcases co-op Colossus boss battle, live November 18
Once Human thrives on the New Weird design philosophy – taking the familiar and twisting it into a nightmare. For Season 5, we wanted to apply this philosophy not just to the visuals, but to the audio itself. As we realized players always take background music for granted, we decided to weaponize it.
Inspired by the cathedral pipe organ, a human symbol of sanctity and solemnity, and through the lens of the New Weird, we distorted this familiar object into a cosmic, biomechanical monstrosity: What if the music wasn’t just playing in your headset, but was the literal breathing and judgment of a cosmic monstrosity watching your every move?
To ground this massive concept in actual gameplay, we’ve warped the open world with four distinct Emotion Zones: Joy, Anger, Sorrow, and Fear.
In these erratic regions, your arsenal becomes an instrument. Defeating enemies scatters musical notes across the battlefield. By shooting these notes, you not only trigger pitch-tuned audio to improvise your own battle rhythms, but also collect them to purify dissonant, corrupted scores. Once these notes are rearranged into harmonious melodies, the scores grant your squad powerful rewards. And as you perform these deadly battle rhythms, the Sky Colossus above will react dynamically, shifting its visual expressions in real-time.
Once the Sky Colossus descends and lingers long enough, the world itself splits open—a rift portal emerges, daring your squad to step through and face the music directly.
Gear up, tune your weapons, and get ready to conduct the apocalypse when Once Human Season 5: Dissonant Resonance drops November 18 on PS5!
What if a sky-spanning Colossus didn’t just loom overhead as a static backdrop, but actively listened and responded to your every gunshot? That’s the core question driving our upcoming fifth season, Dissonant Resonance, free to play and launching globally on November 18. Today, I want to take you behind the scenes to share how we are turning sound and emotion into your greatest weapons – and your biggest threats.
New weird meets a symphony of dread

Discover the world and core gameplay of Vindictus: Defying Fate.
Vindictus: Defying Fate comes to PS5 next year
Hello, PlayStation players. I’m Dongseok Oh, lead director of the high-octane action-RPG Vindictus: Defying Fate . Our team is building a medieval fantasy adventure where heroes must stand against colossal foes in a world inspired by Celtic mythology and, today, we’re officially revealing that Vindictus: Defying Fate is coming to PS5. I’m honored to have this opportunity to introduce the core gameplay and world to the PlayStation community.
Visceral, engaging combat is key to the Vindictus: Defying Fate experience. So much so, that weapons are the first step when we conceptualize our heroes. We carefully consider a wide range of weapons, from familiar ones players expect to see to more unconventional options that offer unique and exciting combat possibilities, and choose one as the foundation.
Ruled by this fateful prophecy, the Humans and Fomors of Taranúil have long soaked the land in each other’s blood.
You must face your fate as a new recruit of the Kalbram Mercenaries, working under the Rocheste Order. As you set out on your journey, you’ll uncover a shadowy plot hiding beneath old conflicts.
As you explore the world of Vindictus, you’ll encounter breathtaking lands still touched by the breath of ancient gods, and thriving centers of human culture that have blossomed even amid war.
Defy your fate The prophecy has already been spoken. Yet only a hero’s single step forward can rise above that fate. Now, it’s your turn to defy it. The PlayStation Store page for Vindictus: Defying Fate is now live and you can add the game to your wishlist .
Our teams behind narrative, combat actions, and appearance are given freedom to explore their own designs and express their creativity before the overall direction is established, crafting a hero with a distinct combat style. Who you choose to play will yield an entirely different experience. You can devote yourself to the one hero who captures your heart, or develop several heroes and choose the right one as the situation demands.
